maintenance_led.reason: Sells precision motors, drives, controls and power quality products to OEMs for new systems, not mainly aftermarket repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private OEMs in industrial, vehicle, medical and aerospace markets; defense is only a portion.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through a mix of organic sales and acquisitions; many former brands came by deals, but it isn't a pure roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Custom motors and drives are designed into OEM products, so switching requires re-qualification, especially in aerospace, defense and medical.

notes: Acquisitions have been a meaningful growth route, so the serial-acquirer call is borderline.
